notes.title: New Hotfix to My Cozy Room!
notes.content: [h2]Dear Cozy Designers![/h2][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your extremely helpful feedback! Listening to your requests, we have prepared for you a Hotfix 1.1 to My Cozy Room! 📢📢📢[/h3][p][/p][p]What exactly will you find in the update? Firstly, to maximize your design experience, we have made [b]improvements in cursor functionality🖱️[/b].[/p][p]We also [b]tweaked the lighting[/b], and for those who appreciate playing by their own rules, quietly 😌, we set the [b]default ambient volume to 0 🔇[/b], and [b]lowered the volume of SFX 🔉[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/fb93a7326e2fab6ae6282439d8a8d668f2f9485f.png"][/img][/p][p]We're constantly taking in your feedback and working behind the scenes to implement as much as possible as quickly as possible. Thank you for your continued support! 🌞💞[/p][p][b]We hope you will enjoy playing My Cozy Room even more now![/b] 🛋️💖🧸[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 3 – Capture the Vibes – Using Photomode & Lighting for the Perfect Shot
notes.content:
[h2]Hi hello cozy decorators!
[/h2]
My Cozy Room gives you all the tools you need to not only design the perfect space, but also capture it beautifully. With Photomode, you can take clean, UI-free screenshots to show off every detail of your creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/7ff992947ab43691fb5efd2abfac056821964ab8.png[/img]

You can also switch the time of day with a single click! What will enhance the atmosphere of your room more? Will it perhaps be the morning light, golden sunsets, or a calm night glow? The choice is all yours!

Combined with camera controls that let you hold your angles, smooth zoom, and ambient music options, you have full creative freedom to set the mood exactly the way you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/e2253f70ce3a52a6daab150206827f9e8b501134.jpg[/img]

So go ahead – style your dream room, frame the perfect shot, and share your cozy masterpiece with the world!

notes.title: Devlog 2 – Classic chic or rockin' feistiness? – Here are all the styles of My C
notes.content:
[h2]Hello interior stylists!
[/h2]

When we set out to build My Cozy Room, we didn’t just want to give you lots of furniture –we wanted to give you moods. Vibes. Atmospheres. Spaces that feel like you. That’s why we created a wide variety of themed items, wallpapers, and floors that let you decorate not just a room, but a whole aesthetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/c7e9464d9fe4bbe282ad2636108e380c4dcc5333.png[/img]

In the new full version of the game, all style packs are included from the start – so you can explore, combine, and reinvent your cozy space however you like.
In My Cozy Room, the fun of mixing and matching themes never ends! Combine bold rock decor with sweet Valentine’s Day wallpapers, and sprinkle in a few holiday touches for a truly unique space. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/b26e1989e2439584402c979e4db56b2caf71f25a.png[/img]

With over a dozen themed sets to explore – including art, cats, dogs, Easter, Halloween, summer, rustic cottagecore, and Mediterranean vibes – you’ll have no shortage of inspiration. Each set includes 20 furniture and decorative items, plus at least 2 themed wallpapers and 1 floor pattern to help bring your vision to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/1afe66c5f7402ed53c28285b5d91c5d56704e443.png[/img]

Combine Mediterranean tiles with Rock decor. Add a Halloween wallpaper to your cozy Cottagecore bedroom. It’s your room – make it weird, elegant, joyful, or chaotic. We love it!
